#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "=== before ==="; docker system df

docker container prune -f --filter "until={{age_hours}}h"
docker image prune -af --filter "until={{age_hours}}h"
docker volume ls -qf dangling=true | xargs -r docker volume rm
docker network prune -f
docker builder prune -af --filter "unused-for={{age_hours}}h"

echo "=== after ==="; docker system df
